footnote_text: Represents shares of common stock issuable upon the settlement of performance-based restricted stock units ("PSUs"), which were subject to both performance-based criteria and time-based vesting. On November 11, 2026, the Compensation Committee of the Company's Board of Directors certified that the performance-based criteria had been satisfied as to 100% of the PSUs. As a result, the PSUs are now subject only to the following time-based vesting schedule: 100% of the PSUs shall vest on November 20, 2026, the first Company Vesting Date (as such term is defined in the applicable PSU grant agreement) that occurs after the certification date, subject to the Reporting Person's continued service through such date.
